conflicts.resolution: No release titled exactly 'Jackfruit Traxx 1' exists in any source. The only physical release of the Jackfruit Traxx sublabel with volume number 1 is 'Traxx Salad Vol. 1' (cat. JFXX1, the label's first vinyl release, described by the label itself as 'Jackfruit Traxx Salad Vol.1'); the input title is treated as label + volume shorthand.
Chose 'No Place Like Heim' (Discogs, the only database entry); '(Vinyl Only)' is treated as a shop/format annotation, not part of the title, and is recorded as a flag.
Sublabel JackFruit Traxx as credited on the Discogs release; shops file it under the parent label Jackfruit Recordings.

reasoning: No source has a release literally named 'Jackfruit Traxx 1'; the label's own blurb identifies JFXX1 as the first vinyl release of the Jackfruit Traxx sublabel, titled 'Traxx Salad Vol. 1'. Discogs holds exactly one entry for cat. JFXX1 (release 36475918, DE 2026, 12" vinyl, 4 tracks), and three independent shops (selectedwax, decks.de, techno-import) confirm the same four positions A1 Nesi 'Old School', A2 Dompe 'Last Days Of Disko', B1 Dompe 'No Place Like Heim' (vinyl only), B2 Nils Ohrmann 'Che (Edgar Peng Remix)', the latter with Edgar Peng as remixer. The vinyl carries no printed durations and no barcode; durations for A1/A2/B2 are taken from the label's digital edition (5:30 / 6:03 / 5:32) and flagged as coming from another edition. B1 has no published duration. Title mismatch and label naming are recorded as conflicts, hence confidence 0.7.
